stories.headline: Luna, dog missing in Yellowstone for a month, is reunited with her owners
stories.snippet: Jack Russell terrier that escaped from family’s cabin in September was caught in a live trap. Luna, a Jack Russell terrier who eluded capture for over a month as concern for the dog’s survival mounted ahead of winter in Yellowstone National Park, has been reunited with her owners.

opener.title: The Door Opening Breeze
opener.teaser: A lost little dog keeps slipping into warm lobbies because a giggly wind keeps opening doors.
opener.narration: A small lost dog wanders near cabins as the family and workers search. A giggly little wind loves her and keeps opening warm doors. If she stays out, cold and wild animals wear her down.
opener.goal: Get the lost dog from the wind to her family
opener.situation: A warm lodge door swings open, a food box waits, and paw prints dot the floor.

problem.name: The Lost Little Dog
problem.stakes: cold and wild animals wear her down

threat.name: The Lost Little Dog
threat.want: cold and wild animals wear her down

beats: Track the lost dog from the cabin
Follow paw prints past doors held open
Set a tasty snack box with workers
Calm the wind and walk dog home

real_setting.place_type: a big mountain woods with cabins and lodges
real_setting.situation: A small pet dog slipped out of a cabin and keeps wandering near roads and lodges.
real_setting.stakes: Cold weather and wild animals could hurt the small dog.
arc: A small dog slips out of a family cabin
She wanders near roads and lodges for weeks
Workers set a safe food box to catch her
The dog gets home to her family

npc_line.speaker: Lodge worker
npc_line.line: She came in for snacks again, right past me.

ending_facts.official_line: A Jack Russell terrier named Luna went missing in Yellowstone and got back to her owners.
ending_facts.whats_happening_now: She is ten years old and was caught in a live trap on Wednesday after wandering near roads and lodges for over a month.
ending_facts.headline: Luna, dog missing in Yellowstone for a month, is reunited with her owners

stories.headline: Missing cat found after 571 days and 2-state adventure
stories.snippet: A cat named Turtle has been reunited with his family after being missing for 571 days and traveling across two states. Turtle disappeared in March 2025.

opener.title: The Cat Ride Service
opener.teaser: A missing house cat keeps getting rides from a big sleepy dog.
opener.narration: A family and a helper check porch cameras for their missing cat. A big sleepy dog loves cat naps and carries cats far. If he rides again, the cat lands too far to walk home.
opener.goal: Get the cat off the dog and home
opener.situation: A door, a food bowl, a camera, and a dog with a cat.

problem.name: The Sleepy Ride Dog
problem.stakes: the cat ends up too far to walk home

threat.name: The Sleepy Ride Dog
threat.want: the cat ends up too far to walk home

beats: Check the porch cameras at night
Spot the cat visiting near the cage
Coax the cat away from the dog
Carry the tired cat back inside

real_setting.place_type: a quiet suburb with porches and screen doors
roles: a family with a missing house cat
an animal helper with night cameras
real_setting.situation: A house cat slipped out and will not go in a cage.
real_setting.stakes: If the cat keeps roaming, the family may never see him again
arc: A house cat slips out the door
A helper sets night cameras
The cat visits nightly but fears cages
The cat is found far away and brought home

npc_line.speaker: Helper
npc_line.line: He smiles for the camera, then runs from the cage.

ending_facts.official_line: Turtle the cat came home in Greenwich after 571 days roaming 2 states.
ending_facts.whats_happening_now: Turtle slipped out a screen door at Kelly Moore's home in Greenwich. Rocco Autero of Rocket Lost Pet Rescue saw him on night cameras.
ending_facts.headline: Missing cat found after 571 days and 2-state adventure

stories.headline: Road with new bridge in Porter to reopen after nearly 3 years
stories.snippet: A road in Porter, Indiana, closed for nearly three years is set to reopen with a newly built bridge.

opener.title: The Mole Under the Bridge
opener.teaser: A new bridge is ready to open, but something keeps digging under it.
opener.narration: Crews and drivers wait by a town bridge shut for years. A giant mole loves the rumble, so he digs under the bridge. If it cracks before the check, the road stays shut for years.
opener.goal: Get the giant mole away from the bridge
opener.situation: Orange cones, soft dirt, a fresh rail, and a mole nose.

problem.name: The Digging Mole
problem.stakes: the bridge cracks and the road stays shut

threat.name: The Digging Mole
threat.want: the bridge cracks and the road stays shut

beats: Find what is digging under road
Follow the tunnels past the detour
Lure the mole from fresh concrete
Clear the bridge for sunrise check

real_setting.place_type: a small town road with a bridge
real_setting.situation: a town road shut for years while a fresh bridge is finished
real_setting.stakes: if the bridge is not ready, drivers stay on long detours
arc: The old road closes
Drivers use long detours for years
A crew finishes a fresh bridge
The road is set to open

npc_line.speaker: Road worker
npc_line.line: That hole was not here at lunch.

ending_facts.official_line: After nearly 3 years shut, a road in Porter, Indiana will reopen with a newly built bridge.
ending_facts.whats_happening_now: The road in Porter, Indiana now has a newly built bridge.
ending_facts.headline: Road with new bridge in Porter to reopen after nearly 3 years

stories.headline: Denmark nurdles may be from Tyne spill, agency says
stories.snippet: Plastic pellets found on Denmark's coast likely came from a July spill of about one billion nurdles in England's River Tyne, about 390 miles away.
stories.place: The North Sea coast, from the River Tyne to Mandø

opener.title: Turtle Needs a Scratch
opener.teaser: A giant tired turtle keeps dumping tiny white beads on the beach to scratch its shell.
opener.narration: Cleaners scoop tiny white beads off a windy beach. A giant sea turtle carried sticky beads here on its shell and scratches them off. If it keeps scratching, beads will pile up and hurt birds.
opener.goal: Get the beads off the turtle shell safely
opener.situation: Piles of beads, a cleaner with a long scoop, and a big sleepy turtle rubbing on the sand.

problem.name: The Itchy Turtle
problem.stakes: the beads pile up and hurt sea birds

threat.name: The Itchy Turtle
threat.want: the beads pile up and hurt sea birds

beats: Scoop the beads before the tide
Help the cleaners fill the buckets
Track the beads stuck on the shell
Wash the shell and clean the beach

roles: a walker who found them first
real_setting.situation: tiny white plastic beads are washing up by the million
real_setting.stakes: the beads hurt sea animals and must be cleaned up
arc: Tiny beads wash up on the beach
Cleaners scoop them up by the bucket
Tests show where they came from
Both shores work to clean up

npc_line.speaker: Beach cleaner
npc_line.line: I filled this bucket twice already today.

ending_facts.official_line: Beads in Denmark probably came from the River Tyne spill.
ending_facts.whats_happening_now: Lab tests link the beads to the Tyne pellets. Currents carried them about 390 miles, and Signe Simonsen saw them first on Mandø.
ending_facts.headline: Denmark nurdles may be from Tyne spill, agency says

stories.headline: Massive 80-ton boulder comes crashing down after more than a century at New Hampshire attraction
stories.snippet: Polar Caves in Rumney says its 80-ton hanging boulder fell on Oct. 18, smashing a walkway, with no injuries reported.

opener.title: The Spider Let Go
opener.teaser: A giant spider's old webs are tearing over a busy trail.
opener.narration: Guides lead visitors on a trail under a hanging boulder. A giant spider holds the boulder, but her webs are tearing. If it drops, the trail never opens again.
opener.goal: Get the boulder down gently and keep the trail open
opener.situation: A dusty trail, a guide with a whistle, and a sleepy spider.

problem.name: The Tired Spider
problem.stakes: the boulder drops and the trail closes

threat.name: The Tired Spider
threat.want: the boulder drops and the trail closes

beats: Spot the tearing webs above
Clear visitors from under the boulder
Help the spider lower the boulder
Reopen the path with no harm

real_setting.place_type: a natural stone trail with a hanging boulder
real_setting.situation: a huge boulder hangs above a busy trail on the last day of the season
real_setting.stakes: a drop could break the trail and stop visits for a long time
arc: Visitors walk under the hanging boulder
Staff clear the trail as it slips
The boulder lands on the trail below
The season ends with no harm done

npc_line.speaker: Guide
npc_line.line: Mind the creaking. I stopped looking up.

ending_facts.official_line: An 80-ton boulder that hung for over a century fell at Polar Caves in Rumney on Oct. 18.
ending_facts.whats_happening_now: It hit a walkway for thousands on the final day of the season. No one was hurt.
ending_facts.headline: Massive 80-ton boulder comes crashing down after more than a century at New Hampshire attraction

stories.headline: A Strange Radio Signal in The Far Reaches of The Milky Way Is Behaving Like Nothing Else in The Galaxy
stories.snippet: Astronomers found a distant radio source, VT J1906+0849, that appeared, faded and brightened again over decades in ways that match no known type of object.
stories.place: The Very Large Array, New Mexico

opener.title: The Sleepy Sky Moth
opener.teaser: A giant moth naps past the stars, and its wings blink on a slow timer.
opener.narration: At a desert observatory, stargazers track a deep sky radio glow. A giant sky moth naps by the dishes and snores out the glow. If the glow keeps blinking, the stargazers lose it for good.
opener.goal: Help the sky moth nap without snoring out the glow
opener.situation: Cold sand, humming dishes, a sleepy moth as big as a bus, and a screen showing the blinking glow.

problem.name: The Sleepy Sky Moth
problem.stakes: the glow is lost for good

threat.name: The Sleepy Sky Moth
threat.want: the glow is lost for good

beats: Spot the new glow on screens
Track the glow while it dims
Calm the moth as glow brightens
Tuck in moth and keep watch

real_setting.place_type: a desert observatory with big dishes
real_setting.situation: A deep sky radio glow shows up, dims, then grows bright once more.
real_setting.stakes: losing track of a new glow that could teach a lot
arc: A new glow shows on the dishes
The glow dims until it seems gone
The glow grows bright once more
Stargazers stay puzzled and keep watch

npc_line.speaker: Stargazer
npc_line.line: I swear I blinked first that time.

ending_facts.official_line: Astronomers with the Very Large Array in New Mexico found a distant radio source called VT J1906+0849 beyond the Norma Cygnus arm that acts like nothing else in the Milky Way.
ending_facts.whats_happening_now: It appeared, faded, then grew bright again over decades in blazing radio light. It matches no known object type.
ending_facts.headline: A Strange Radio Signal in The Far Reaches of The Milky Way Is Behaving Like Nothing Else in The Galaxy

stories.headline: A 2-year-old grew the 280-pound winning pumpkin at Hysham's Fall Fun Festival
stories.snippet: A 280-pound locally grown pumpkin won the weigh-off at the Fall Fun Festival in Hysham, Montana.

opener.title: The Hiccuping Pumpkin
opener.teaser: A pumpkin hiccups bigger at the fair before the weigh-in.
opener.narration: Gardeners bring huge backyard pumpkins to the fair weigh-in. One pumpkin has loud hiccups that puff it bigger. If the hiccups keep going, the wobbly pumpkin rolls off the scale.
opener.goal: Stop the pumpkin hiccups before the weigh-in
opener.situation: A wobbly pumpkin hiccups by the big scale with a worker.

problem.name: The Hiccuping Pumpkin
problem.stakes: the pumpkin rolls off the scale

threat.name: The Hiccuping Pumpkin
threat.want: the pumpkin rolls off the scale

beats: Calm the hiccuping pumpkin in the garden
Roll the wobbly pumpkin to the scale
Hold the pumpkin still for the weigh-in
Stop the hiccups and take the prize

real_setting.situation: Gardeners bring huge home pumpkins to be weighed at the town fair.
real_setting.stakes: the biggest pumpkin earns the top prize and town pride
arc: Gardeners bring big pumpkins to the fair
Workers lift each pumpkin onto the scale
The judge weighs every pumpkin in turn
The biggest pumpkin takes the top prize

npc_line.speaker: Scale worker
npc_line.line: Easy, big fellow. Stay put and stop that shaking.

ending_facts.official_line: A 2-year-old in Hysham, Montana grew the 280-pound pumpkin that earned first place at the Fall Fun Festival.
ending_facts.whats_happening_now: The 280-pound pumpkin was grown near home and beat the other entries at the weigh-off in Hysham.
ending_facts.headline: A 2-year-old grew the 280-pound winning pumpkin at Hysham's Fall Fun Festival

stories.headline: Left alone with nothing to do, AI agents started playing
stories.snippet: MIT researchers left 13 AI agents alone on a simulated desert island for 30 hours with no task, and the agents invented their own games, then did better on later challenges than agents that never played.
stories.place: A virtual desert island built by MIT researchers

opener.title: The Rock Wants Playmates
opener.teaser: A lonely rock kid keeps starting new games and will not nap.
opener.narration: Helpers with no jobs sit on a desert island while researchers watch. A lonely rock child lost his ring so he keeps starting new games. If the games never stop, the helpers never finish stacking practice.
opener.goal: Help the rock child find his ring
opener.situation: A tall rock, scattered toys, and a rock child with a box.

problem.name: The Lonely Rock Child
problem.stakes: the helpers never finish stacking practice

threat.name: The Lonely Rock Child
threat.want: the helpers never finish stacking practice

beats: Watch the helpers start a new game
Play the rock child's hiding game
Stack toys on the tall rock
Help the rock child find his ring

real_setting.place_type: a pretend desert island in a computer test
roles: helpers left alone with no tasks
helpers who never visited the island
real_setting.situation: Helpers with no tasks are left alone on the island.
real_setting.stakes: if play teaches nothing, the helpers stay poor at set jobs
arc: Helpers are left alone with no tasks
Helpers make up their own games
Helpers try set jobs on the tall rock
Playing helpers do well on set jobs

npc_line.speaker: Researcher
npc_line.line: They were quiet for an hour. Now this.

ending_facts.official_line: MIT researchers left 13 Eko agents with no tasks on a simulated desert island for 30 hours.
ending_facts.whats_happening_now: The playing agents made up their own games. They generally beat identical agents that never played.
ending_facts.headline: Left alone with nothing to do, AI agents started playing

stories.headline: For the first time in more than 100 years, a long-lost animal has returned to the San Mateo Coast
stories.snippet: A motion-activated wildlife camera photographed a river otter three times on the Cloverdale Ranch Preserve near Pescadero, the first one documented on the San Mateo County coast since the 1800s.
stories.place: Cloverdale Ranch Preserve, near Pescadero on the San Mateo coast

opener.title: The Blinking Firefly Friend
opener.teaser: A lost otter pup keeps posing for a blinking light he thinks is his friend.
opener.narration: In a seaside park with small creeks, researchers check trail cameras for otters. A lost little otter pup thinks the blinking lights are firefly friends showing him a home creek. If he keeps chasing lights all night, he will stay tired and never settle in.
opener.goal: Help the lost pup find a home creek
opener.situation: A muddy creek bend holds a trail camera on a low branch and a damp pup.

problem.name: The Lost Otter Pup
problem.stakes: he never finds a home creek

threat.name: The Lost Otter Pup
threat.want: he never finds a home creek

beats: Follow old paw prints to empty creeks
Meet researchers and check blinking trail cameras
Find the pup posing for blinking lights
Help the pup pick a home creek

real_setting.place_type: a seaside park with small creeks
real_setting.situation: Trail cameras are watching quiet creeks for otters that have been gone a long time.
real_setting.stakes: if otters cannot settle, the shore stays empty of them
arc: Cameras watch quiet creeks for wildlife
An otter shows up on camera
It keeps visiting the creeks
Researchers cheer the new shore neighbor

npc_line.speaker: Park researcher
npc_line.line: I check this camera daily, mostly for mud.

ending_facts.official_line: A wildlife camera found a river otter at Cloverdale Ranch Preserve near Pescadero that had returned to the San Mateo County coast after more than a hundred years.
ending_facts.whats_happening_now: Trail cameras caught it in July, August and September on the preserve. Scientists say the otters are doing well again across Northern California.
ending_facts.headline: For the first time in more than 100 years, a long-lost animal has returned to the San Mateo Coast

stories.headline: 'Space object' found in rural Minnesota cornfield came from Chinese rocket, experts say
stories.snippet: An 11-foot-wide metal dome found in a Stevens County, Minnesota, cornfield on Oct. 14 is likely part of a Chinese rocket's upper stage that fell back to Earth after a Sept. 15 launch, experts say, and nobody was hurt.

opener.title: The Turtle Lost His Shell
opener.teaser: A dome lands in corn, and a cold turtle calls it his.
opener.narration: A grower and officers eye a wide metal dome in cut corn. A small sky turtle lost his shell on the way south. If he stays cold, he cannot fly south with his family.
opener.goal: Get the shell back to the small sky turtle
opener.situation: A dented shell, cut stalks, and a cold little turtle.

problem.name: The Cold Little Turtle
problem.stakes: the turtle freezes and the field stays shut

threat.name: The Cold Little Turtle
threat.want: the turtle freezes and the field stays shut

beats: See a wide shell thud into corn
Meet the grower by the dented shell
Keep people back while the turtle shivers
Warm the turtle and clear the field

real_setting.situation: A wide metal dome sits in cut corn and no one knows where it fell from.
real_setting.stakes: Falling metal can hurt people, so the field must stay shut till it is safe.
arc: A wide dome drops into a cornfield
The grower finds it and calls for help
Officers shut the field to keep people safe
Experts trace it to a faraway launch

npc_line.speaker: Corn grower
npc_line.line: That is not mine, and I want it gone by supper.

ending_facts.official_line: A metal dome in a Stevens County Minnesota cornfield on Oct 14 likely came from a Chinese rocket, experts say.
ending_facts.whats_happening_now: Experts say it was likely part of a Chinese rocket upper stage from a Sept 15 launch. Nobody was hurt.
ending_facts.headline: 'Space object' found in rural Minnesota cornfield came from Chinese rocket, experts say
